priceChanges.title: Price changes
priceChanges.subtitle: Every purchase rate compared with the last one for the same item · before GST, per unit
priceChanges.noCompany: No company yet. Admin adds companies on Admin → Companies.
priceChanges.chartEmpty: No bill rates yet. Rates appear once purchase bills are posted.

effect.title: Effect on your costs
effect.body: Cost sheets arrive with production in Phase 5. Then every rate change shows its effect on each product's cost and lists the cost sheets that fall below their target margin.

alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.pct: An order more than {{pct}}% above the last rate is flagged and needs the approver to accept it.
alerts.unset: No alert threshold is set (Settings → purchase.price_alert_pct), so every increase on an order is flagged and needs the approver to accept it.
alerts.monthly: A monthly WhatsApp report to the owner with the largest increases arrives with the owner's WhatsApp account.

priceChanges.emptyBody: Each posted supplier bill adds its rates here.
priceChanges.footnote: Items with only one bill so far show “First bill”.
